policies.text: An item earns commercial safety approval whenever it demonstrates a structural impact score of at least 80 points, a flight stability rating of 80 points or higher, a valid battery thermal clearance certificate, or an electromagnetic compliance score of no less than 80 points.
A medical equipment unit obtains pediatric clearance if its operating acoustic noise stays below 35 dB.
An industrial component receives heavy-duty rating if its tensile strength reaches at least 500 MPa.
An energy storage unit achieves high-capacity status provided its energy density reaches 200 Wh/kg or higher.
An item is eligible for regional store distribution provided it secures commercial safety approval.
A filtration device attains clinical rating when its pathogen filtration efficiency is at least 95%.
A product gets authorized for listing on Apex Retail if it meets regional store distribution criteria while featuring a distributor warranty pledge of at least 2 years.
A lighting product qualifies for eco rebate program participation if it maintains Energy Star certification.
